newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Jailed Australian drugs baron Savvas dead.
newsitem.headline: Jailed Australian drugs baron Savvas dead.

text.p: Jailed Australian drug smuggler George Savvas was found dead in his prison cell on Sunday after attempting a jail break with Australia's most notorious serial killer Ivan Milat.
Australian police said Savvas' body was found hanging in his cell less than 24 hours after authorities foiled an escape plan he had planned with Milat and two others.
"He had been seen by a few people last night, obviously being questioned about the escape," Australian Associated Press quoted a Corrective Services spokeswoman as saying.
"It's fair to say that everyone here's very surprised. His personality would not be one where you would expect him to do something like that," she said.
"He's had a big disappointment yesterday, I suppose you have to take that into account."
The spokeswoman said an inquest would be held into the death, a standard procedure when a prisoner dies in custody.
Savvas, 47, had served about six-and-a-half years of a 30-year sentence for conspiring to import heroin.
He escaped from another jail in July last year and was recaptured on March 20 at an exclusive Japanese restaurant in Sydney after police were tipped off.
Milat, 51, is serving a life sentence for the murder of seven backpackers, including five Europeans, outside Sydney.
